exercise.prompt:
Analyse a class test. Read the marks as whole numbers on one line, separated by spaces.
1. Print `Highest:` and the highest mark.
2. Print `Lowest:` and the lowest mark.
3. Print `Range:` and the difference between them.
4. Print `Above average:` and how many marks are greater than the average.
exercise.promptHi:
Ek class test ka analysis karo. Marks ek line mein whole numbers ki tarah padho, spaces se alag.
1. `Highest:` aur sabse zyada mark print karo.
2. `Lowest:` aur sabse kam mark print karo.
3. `Range:` aur dono ka farak print karo.
4. `Above average:` aur kitne marks average se zyada hain, print karo.
exercise.starterCode: # Read the marks on one line
